page.overview:
Who is Goyathlay Soundman?

Goyathlay Soundman (ゴヤスレー・サウンドマン Goyasurē saundoman) is a character featured in the light novel JORGE JOESTAR. He is a counterpart of Sandman from the 37th universe, and wields the Bound, Dune. He was an astronaut who boarded the H.G. Wells, along with Captain Funnier Valentine who later betrayed and killed him.

Unlike his original counterpart, Soundman is fully-clothed and maintains a similar hairstyle just without braids. His short has a similar native design and has shoulder and elbow pads.

Soundman wields the Bound, Dune. It allows Soundman to create sand and manipulate it at will. Soundmans entire body is made out of sand. Kars creates his own, more superior variant of Dune which he names Dune Ultimate.
